spanish: Y si no alcanzare su mano a dos tórtolas o a dos hijos de paloma, y traerá su ofrenda que pecó, décima del efa sólet a pecado; no pondrá sobre ella aceite, y no dará sobre ella incienso, porque pecado ella.

findings.issue: sólet is the Hebrew common noun left untranslated; the token licenses a Spanish noun, not a transliteration.
«que pecó» makes the offering the sinner. חָטָא is qal perfect 3ms with no expressed subject, so the sinner stays open between the bringer and the masculine offering.

notes: The other clauses match the tokens, including verbless כי חטאת היא.
